steps.decision: Measurement system judged acceptable (AIAG: percentGRR 10-30 = acceptable, NDC>=5 adequate resolution). Declared grr_pct and ndc to steward, which unlocked the outer diameter batch.
Outer diameter run is in statistical control on both X-bar and R charts; no special cause detected.
Shapiro-Wilk p=0.518, Anderson-Darling stat=0.39 (well below common critical value); diameter data consistent with normal distribution.
Outer diameter is highly capable and well centered (mean 25.0007 vs target 25.0); normal-theory capability is appropriate given the normality result in step 3.

Wall thickness R chart flags 4 out-of-control subgroups (indices 20,21,22,24; sampling points about 100 to 124), a cluster of excess within-subgroup spread near the end of the run. X-bar chart shows no shift.
Shapiro-Wilk p under 0.0001, Anderson-Darling stat=3.75 (far above critical values); wall thickness data is not normal, left-skewed, driven by the out-of-control subgroups from step 5.

Computed for reference only; rejected as the basis for a conclusion because step 6 shows the data fails normality, so normal-theory Cp Cpk Pp Ppk overstate capability here. See step 8 for the accepted figure.
Percentile-based non-normal capability is the accepted figure: Ppk=0.89, below the conventional 1.0 capable floor. Wall thickness is the characteristic driving process risk.

Significant difference in mean outer diameter across the four turning fixtures (p=0.011); fixture 4 runs highest (mean 25.0209 mm) and fixture 2 lowest (mean 24.9825 mm). This is a secondary finding on diameter, which remains capable overall, not on wall thickness.
No linear relationship between coolant delivery pressure and wall thickness (r=-0.005, p=0.97). Coolant pressure is ruled out as a driver of the wall thickness variability seen in step 5.

inputs_digest.question: root cause of wall thickness range-chart excursions near sampling points 100 to 125

steps.decision: Process owner had no recorded process fact for this question (provision refused as unroutable, no topics on file). Root cause of the special-cause variation in wall thickness is not established from available data; this is a genuine gap, not filled in.

route_decisions.chosen_branch: coolant delivery pressure ruled out; root cause unresolved
